notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547087/278ce4cb924b8da7f335847cfeda2738961829d7.png[/img]

Changes:
- Speedrun mode added.
- Tutorial updated for level 1. Using Arbo rune is now shown as a gif.
- Decreased distance for one of the stone ramps in level 4. This jump proved to be very difficult, and could annoy players. Now it's slightly easier.

How to access speedrun mode?
It's going to be available after completing the main game. If you have previously completed the game, unfortunately you will have to see "The End" credits once again. If you still have your last save file, this can be done in 10 seconds. Load the save, you should be in the last level. close to the end. Choose "No". Just after "The End" credits, The Speedrun Rabbit should be visible in the main menu. Good luck on your runs!
